items.headline: Trey Smack’s OT kick lifts the Packers past the Jets, ending a 6-game skid
items.description: — Trey Smack kicked a 26-yard field goal in overtime and the Green Bay Packers overcame a 10-point fourth-quarter deficit and a sloppy, penalty-filled performance to snap a six-game skid with a 20-17 victory over the New York Jets on Sunday.
